answer: An adversary hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The harbor counter is kept in wharf and karst shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 836 identities would post 4804 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
